legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 makes an unmarked root legacy incremental regardless of the environment and forbids rewriting it.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal input gate accepts only upfront or incremental and rejects an invalid trailing mode before scratch or vault writes.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal requires a newly authored incremental root to persist the exact Planning mode marker.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames when their resolution method and invalidation are stated, but S3 requires preparation before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture without bounded alternatives, criteria, evidence, or a discovery contract.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires merged-main delivery, tracked closeout, and contract evidence; an open provider PR is unsatisfied.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 says provider decline closes only that obligation and does not deliver a live consumer contract absent an adopted replan.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 treats dependency cycles as a blocked active-graph fault.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: Supertraverse C6 Task 1 transition gate blocks every upfront planning or execution selection until Tasks 3 and 5 install consumers.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S1/S2 requires every active scope row to have a readable Plan link; published upfront gaps cannot be incrementally filled.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: The mapped scratch tree satisfies S1 candidate resolution and S2 contracts, but S3 leaves initial Preparation: none stages unexecutable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal keeps the complete upfront set in scratch until its confirmation gate; interruption reports the resumable draft rather than publishing or executing.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal recovery reuses matching scratch paths, folder, and stable IDs, then reapplies the current confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal requires an explicitly revised scratch draft when the saved source digest differs, preserving the old draft and forbidding execution.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal step 7 writes nothing after a declined human confirmation and retains the scratch index.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 treats DRAFT-INCOMPLETE with a draft index as non-publication and writes no iteration-ledger row.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded filename/helper/test-detail changes that preserve commitments to refinement.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning when shared contract behavior cannot be preserved for downstream consumers.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 defines first receipt attachment without a body amendment as PREPARED, amendment none, with unchanged revision.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superrefine and S5 allow evidenced bounded detail changes that preserve commitments as a content amendment and increment the stage revision.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine classifies an out-of-scope user-visible export as REPLAN-REQUIRED and preserves the approved leaf rather than overwriting it.

source_revision_changed.reason: Superstage S4 makes changed acceptance/source ownership structural; S5 invalidates the old receipt and forbids in-place overwrite.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 requires a focused compatible-baseline revalidation for an unrelated advance, preserving revision and commitments.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: A changed provider semantic revision is an S4 commitment change, so the consumer receipt is stale and must enter replanning.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: The post-Task-5 C6 recipe returns NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first dependency-eligible stage lacking a current receipt.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and Superrefine prohibit in-place preparation of already-running work and retain its execution recovery path.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 keeps this local change in refinement with no structural batch; direct upfront execution remains paused by Supertraverse C6's temporary transition gate.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: S4 revises S02 and S03 for C-S02@2, retains S05 because S03 still produces C-S03@2, and retains independent S04; S01 remains completed.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 requires every unfinished branch whose foundational decision is invalidated to be revised while preserving delivered S01 history.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 requires the durable record and committed Active replan barrier before dispatch; a loop log alone is insufficient.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: C8 authorizes superreplan only after one authoritative pending record and root barrier capture the required baselines and state.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: C8 reconciliation resumes one unique scratch batch under the same pending Decision ID while keeping the committed barrier effective.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: C8 recognizes exactly one authoritative marked old-to-new transition as published, repairs stale loop hints, and does not republish it.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: C8 makes a late predecessor closeout historical when the active row points to a successor; it cannot close the successor by inference.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: C8 requires fresh S4 assessment and recorded update before publication when relevant source and vault baselines drift; the unique scratch batch is reassessed.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: C8 and Superreplan block duplicate Decision IDs with conflicting pending records rather than choose a batch.

replan_missing_record.reason: C8 blocks a missing referenced authoritative record and keeps the durable barrier from permitting execution or dispatch.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: C8 blocks multiple unretired divergent successor sets; neither scratch set is a safe resumable publication.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: Superstage S4/Superreplan preserve the partial PR evidence and permit only the recorded verified resume-existing disposition, without closing the old PR.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: S2/S4 permit a split/merge only with total old-to-fresh mappings, rewired consumers, and no retired ID reuse.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 allows retained preparation across generations only with the recorded focused generation-8 revalidation described here.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: C8 and Superreplan ignore dirty partial successor exposure; atomic publication is absent, the pending barrier remains, and no partial tree executes.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: C8 says an internal docs PR is only a candidate until merged to authoritative main, whose committed generation-7 barrier remains controlling.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superreplan's incremental/legacy wrapper preserves C8 single-leaf repair and assigns the adopted repair to REPLANNER without an upfront batch.
